{
  "manifest_schema": 1,
  "id": "vendor.controls",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "display_name": "Native controls",
  "host_api": { "minimum": "0.0.1", "maximum": "99.0.0" },
  "protocol": 1,
  "provider": { "mode": "persistent", "binaries": { "aarch64-apple-darwin": "bin/provider", "x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu": "bin/provider" } },
  "actions": [{
    "id": "vendor.controls.open",
    "label": "Open native controls",
    "description": "Open Tree and StructuredDiff controls",
    "category": "vendor.controls",
    "contexts": ["dashboard"],
    "arguments": [],
    "timeout_seconds": 60,
    "destructive": false,
    "confirmation": "none",
    "handler": "open",
    "allowed_outcomes": ["navigate-declared-route"]
  }],
  "panels": [{
    "id": "vendor.controls.tree-diff",
    "model_kinds": ["tree", "structured-diff"],
    "event_schema": [
      { "kind": "selected", "arguments": [] },
      { "kind": "activated", "arguments": [] },
      { "kind": "expansion-changed", "arguments": [] }
    ],
    "handler": "tree-diff",
    "ports": []
  }],
  "routes": [{ "id": "vendor.controls.open", "activation_fields": [], "target_screen": "vendor.controls.review" }],
  "screens": [{ "path": "screens/main.screen.toml", "screen_ids": ["vendor.controls.review"] }]
}

screen_schema = 1
id = "vendor.controls.review"
title = "Native Control Review"
route = "vendor.controls.open"
initial_focus = "review"
focus_order = ["review"]

[[panels]]
id = "review"
type = "vendor.controls.tree-diff"
focusable = true
required = true

[layout]
type = "leaf"
panel = "review"

#!/bin/sh
set -eu
expect_event() {
  expected_revision=$1
  expected_event=$2
  read -r message
  prefix='{"protocol":1,"type":"panel-event","request_id":"'
  remainder=${message#"$prefix"}
  [ "$remainder" != "$message" ] || { printf '%s\n' "unexpected panel event envelope: $message" >&2; exit 41; }
  request_id=${remainder%%\"*}
  digits=${request_id#h-}
  [ "$digits" != "$request_id" ] || { printf '%s\n' "unexpected panel event request id: $message" >&2; exit 41; }
  case "$digits" in
    ''|*[!0-9]*) printf '%s\n' "unexpected panel event request id: $message" >&2; exit 41 ;;
  esac
  expected="{\"protocol\":1,\"type\":\"panel-event\",\"request_id\":\"$request_id\",\"generation\":$process_generation,\"payload\":{\"panel_instance_id\":$panel_instance_id,\"generation\":$panel_generation,\"revision\":$expected_revision,\"event\":$expected_event}}"
  [ "$message" = "$expected" ] || { printf '%s\n' "unexpected panel event: $message" >&2; exit 41; }
}
read -r hello
process_generation=$(printf '%s\n' "$hello" | sed -n 's/.*"generation":\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p')
printf '%s\n' "{\"protocol\":1,\"type\":\"hello-ack\",\"request_id\":\"p-100001\",\"generation\":$process_generation,\"payload\":{\"provider_name\":\"native-controls\",\"protocol\":1}}"
read -r configure
printf '%s\n' "{\"protocol\":1,\"type\":\"ready\",\"request_id\":\"p-100002\",\"generation\":$process_generation,\"payload\":{\"capabilities\":[\"actions\",\"panels\"]}}"
read -r invoke
printf '%s\n' "{\"protocol\":1,\"type\":\"outcome\",\"request_id\":\"p-100003\",\"generation\":$process_generation,\"payload\":{\"kind\":\"navigate\",\"route_id\":\"vendor.controls.open\",\"activation\":{}}}"
read -r activate
panel_instance_id=$(printf '%s\n' "$activate" | sed -n 's/.*"panel_instance_id":\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p')
panel_generation=$(printf '%s\n' "$activate" | sed -n 's/.*"payload":{.*"generation":\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p')
printf '%s\n' "{\"protocol\":1,\"type\":\"panel-snapshot\",\"request_id\":\"p-100004\",\"generation\":$process_generation,\"payload\":{\"model_schema\":1,\"panel_instance_id\":$panel_instance_id,\"generation\":$panel_generation,\"revision\":1,\"kind\":\"tree\",\"title\":\"Native Tree\",\"loading\":false,\"action_affordances\":[],\"body\":{\"kind\":\"tree\",\"schema_version\":1,\"nodes\":[{\"id\":\"root\",\"label\":\"Root node\",\"semantic_key\":\"root-key\",\"depth\":0,\"expandable\":true,\"expanded\":false},{\"id\":\"child\",\"parent_id\":\"root\",\"label\":\"Child node\",\"semantic_key\":\"child-key\",\"depth\":1,\"expandable\":false,\"expanded\":false},{\"id\":\"next\",\"label\":\"Next root\",\"semantic_key\":\"next-key\",\"depth\":0,\"expandable\":false,\"expanded\":false}],\"selected_id\":\"root\"}}}"
expect_event 1 '{"kind":"expansion-changed","id":"root","expanded":true}'
printf '%s\n' "{\"protocol\":1,\"type\":\"panel-snapshot\",\"request_id\":\"p-100005\",\"generation\":$process_generation,\"payload\":{\"model_schema\":1,\"panel_instance_id\":$panel_instance_id,\"generation\":$panel_generation,\"revision\":2,\"kind\":\"tree\",\"title\":\"Expanded Tree\",\"loading\":false,\"action_affordances\":[],\"body\":{\"kind\":\"tree\",\"schema_version\":1,\"nodes\":[{\"id\":\"root\",\"label\":\"Root node\",\"semantic_key\":\"root-key\",\"depth\":0,\"expandable\":true,\"expanded\":true},{\"id\":\"child\",\"parent_id\":\"root\",\"label\":\"Child node\",\"semantic_key\":\"child-key\",\"depth\":1,\"expandable\":false,\"expanded\":false},{\"id\":\"next\",\"label\":\"Next root\",\"semantic_key\":\"next-key\",\"depth\":0,\"expandable\":false,\"expanded\":false}],\"selected_id\":\"root\"}}}"
expect_event 2 '{"kind":"selected","id":"child"}'
printf '%s\n' "{\"protocol\":1,\"type\":\"panel-snapshot\",\"request_id\":\"p-100006\",\"generation\":$process_generation,\"payload\":{\"model_schema\":1,\"panel_instance_id\":$panel_instance_id,\"generation\":$panel_generation,\"revision\":3,\"kind\":\"tree\",\"title\":\"Selected child\",\"loading\":false,\"action_affordances\":[],\"body\":{\"kind\":\"tree\",\"schema_version\":1,\"nodes\":[{\"id\":\"root\",\"label\":\"Root node\",\"semantic_key\":\"root-key\",\"depth\":0,\"expandable\":true,\"expanded\":true},{\"id\":\"child\",\"parent_id\":\"root\",\"label\":\"Child node\",\"semantic_key\":\"child-key\",\"depth\":1,\"expandable\":false,\"expanded\":false},{\"id\":\"next\",\"label\":\"Next root\",\"semantic_key\":\"next-key\",\"depth\":0,\"expandable\":false,\"expanded\":false}],\"selected_id\":\"child\"}}}"
expect_event 3 '{"kind":"activated","id":"child"}'
printf '%s\n' "{\"protocol\":1,\"type\":\"panel-snapshot\",\"request_id\":\"p-100007\",\"generation\":$process_generation,\"payload\":{\"model_schema\":1,\"panel_instance_id\":$panel_instance_id,\"generation\":$panel_generation,\"revision\":4,\"kind\":\"structured-diff\",\"title\":\"Native Structured Diff\",\"loading\":false,\"action_affordances\":[],\"body\":{\"kind\":\"structured-diff\",\"schema_version\":1,\"files\":[{\"id\":\"first\",\"old_path\":\"src/old.rs\",\"new_path\":\"src/new.rs\",\"binary\":true,\"hunks\":[]},{\"id\":\"second\",\"new_path\":\"src/second.rs\",\"binary\":true,\"hunks\":[]}],\"selected_file_id\":\"first\"}}}"
expect_event 4 '{"kind":"selected","id":"second"}'
printf '%s\n' "{\"protocol\":1,\"type\":\"panel-snapshot\",\"request_id\":\"p-100008\",\"generation\":$process_generation,\"payload\":{\"model_schema\":1,\"panel_instance_id\":$panel_instance_id,\"generation\":$panel_generation,\"revision\":5,\"kind\":\"structured-diff\",\"title\":\"Selected second file\",\"loading\":false,\"action_affordances\":[],\"body\":{\"kind\":\"structured-diff\",\"schema_version\":1,\"files\":[{\"id\":\"first\",\"old_path\":\"src/old.rs\",\"new_path\":\"src/new.rs\",\"binary\":true,\"hunks\":[]},{\"id\":\"second\",\"new_path\":\"src/second.rs\",\"binary\":true,\"hunks\":[]}],\"selected_file_id\":\"second\"}}}"
expect_event 5 '{"kind":"activated","id":"second"}'
printf '%s\n' "{\"protocol\":1,\"type\":\"panel-snapshot\",\"request_id\":\"p-100009\",\"generation\":$process_generation,\"payload\":{\"model_schema\":1,\"panel_instance_id\":$panel_instance_id,\"generation\":$panel_generation,\"revision\":6,\"kind\":\"structured-diff\",\"title\":\"Activated second file\",\"loading\":false,\"action_affordances\":[],\"body\":{\"kind\":\"structured-diff\",\"schema_version\":1,\"files\":[{\"id\":\"first\",\"old_path\":\"src/old.rs\",\"new_path\":\"src/new.rs\",\"binary\":true,\"hunks\":[]},{\"id\":\"second\",\"new_path\":\"src/second.rs\",\"binary\":true,\"hunks\":[]}],\"selected_file_id\":\"second\"}}}"
while read -r message; do
  case "$message" in
    *"shutdown"*) printf '%s\n' "{\"protocol\":1,\"type\":\"shutdown-ack\",\"request_id\":\"p-100010\",\"generation\":$process_generation,\"payload\":{}}"; exit 0 ;;
  esac
done
